name: Sunny avocado toast
description: Creamy avocado, crisp toast, and an egg with a golden center.
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and spread it over the toast.
Heat the oil in a small pan. Fry the egg until the white and yolk are firm, then slide it onto the toast.

name: Berry overnight oats
description: A make-ahead jar of creamy oats and bright berries.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, and yogurt together in a covered container.
Refrigerate for at least 6 hours. The listed time is hands-on prep.
Stir again and top with the berries just before eating.

name: Banana oat pancakes
description: A short stack with a soft center and crisp golden edges.
steps: Mash two-thirds of the banana and slice the rest for topping.
Beat the egg and ground oats into the mash.
Heat the oil over medium-low heat. Spoon in small rounds and cook for 2–3 minutes per side until set. Top with sliced banana.

name: Apple yogurt bowl
description: Crunchy apple and warm cinnamon over thick yogurt.
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Core and thinly slice the apple.
Arrange the apple on top and finish with granola and cinnamon.

name: Lemon chickpea bowl
description: A bright, crunchy bowl with lemon dressing and briny feta.
steps: Rinse and drain the chickpeas. Dice the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Whisk the lemon juice and oil in a bowl.
Fold in the vegetables and chickpeas, then scatter the feta on top.

name: Garden hummus wrap
description: A soft tortilla packed with hummus and crisp garden vegetables.
steps: Grate the carrot and cut the cucumber into thin sticks.
Spread hummus over the tortilla, leaving a narrow border.
Layer the vegetables across the center. Fold the sides in, roll tightly, and cut in half.

name: Tomato basil toast
description: Juicy tomatoes and torn basil piled onto toasted bread.
steps: Toast the bread and rub one side with the cut garlic clove.
Dice the tomato and toss with oil and torn basil.
Spoon over the toast just before eating.

name: Peanut noodle salad
description: Cool noodles tossed with crunchy carrots and a peanut dressing.
steps: Cook the noodles according to the packet. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, and lime juice with enough water to coat a spoon.
Grate the carrot and toss it with the noodles and dressing.

name: Skillet tomato pasta
description: A cozy bowl of pasta with a quick garlicky tomato sauce.
steps: Cook the spaghetti according to the packet, reserving a splash of cooking water.
Warm the oil, add the minced garlic, and stir for 30 seconds. Add tomatoes and simmer for 8 minutes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and enough cooking water to loosen it. Tear the basil on top.

name: Black bean tacos
description: Warm tortillas filled with smoky beans and fresh avocado.
steps: Drain the beans. Warm in a pan with cumin and a splash of water for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill with beans, sliced avocado, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Broccoli tofu rice
description: Golden tofu, tender broccoli, and fluffy rice in one bowl.
steps: Pat the tofu dry and cube it. Cook in oil over medium heat for 6–8 minutes, turning to brown.
Add broccoli and a splash of water. Cover for 4 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the soy sauce and cooked rice, and heat until steaming throughout.

name: Coconut lentil curry
description: Soft red lentils simmered with coconut milk and mild spices.
steps: Rinse the lentils until the water runs clear.
Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Cook gently for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add water as needed until the lentils are soft.
